generation.prompt: Use the supplied original V3 terraced-city image as the visual starting reference. Make one continuous five-second cinematic shot that moves gently forward along the processional avenue, toward the illuminated terrace and the distant suspended open arch. The camera is an observer at a believable elevated street-side viewpoint, with a stable horizon and a steady forward direction. Foreground stone and nearby framing buildings shift past the edges more noticeably than the distant city; the S-shaped route gradually opens, and the warm destination terrace becomes clearer. The far monumental arch remains suspended in a stable position above the city and approaches only gradually; preserve its open inverted-U silhouette, block construction, air gaps below its feet and restrained amber inner edge. Preserve the stepped architecture, connected roads, bridges, twilight sky, shadow detail and low warm horizon. Small pedestrians move naturally without attracting the camera. The main change is a change of viewing position and revealed space, not the whole image uniformly zooming, morphing architecture, the arch growing or spinning, or a new building appearing. Keep the journey slow and calm. End still approaching the destination, with the avenue continuing ahead. No cuts, fast flight, orbiting camera, camera roll, labels, subtitles or logos.
